name: Gilt market
summary: 10-year gilt yield near 5.2% ahead of an expected rate rise
state: The 10-year gilt yield was near 5.2% on 2 Nov, below its October high near 19-year peaks but about 75bp higher than a year ago (Trading Economics). A Bank of England rise is widely expected on 5 Nov (Bloomberg). Auctions have been orderly as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Mortgage rates track gilt yields; new fixed-rate deals remain costly.
rubric_hit: Gilt yields near multi-decade highs = Watch

sources.title: Bloomberg — BoE to raise rates, survey shows

why: Gilt yields set UK mortgage rates and the government's borrowing costs; the 2022 LDI crisis showed how fast it can break.
drivers: Fiscal credibility, BoE policy, inflation, global bond moves, pension-fund flows.

rubric.alert: BoE intervention, or 10y moved > 75bp in a month.
rubric.watch: 30y gilt at multi-decade highs, or 10y moved 40–75bp in a month, or a weak auction.
rubric.normal: 10y gilt moved < 40bp in a month and auctions orderly.
